text:
anna (eng-release): Deployed model-serving v1.9.2 ~4m ago. I'm seeing p95 ~1.6s (ok) but p99 jumped to ~12s and we have client 502/504 spikes. Rolling back? :rotating_light:
pagerbot: INCIDENT alert: service/api - elevated 5xx rate (5m avg 6.2%). p99 latency 12.3s. Paging kevin (sre-oncall).
kevin (sre-oncall): on it. Can someone paste the canary traffic split and recent deploy id?
anna (eng-release): deploy id deploy-20260315-1932, canary was 15% traffic. Metrics: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/model-p99 (just opened).
dinesh (infra): I can see a surge of long tails on the new worker nodes (quantized path). JVM/worker logs show frequent stall at kv-cache lookup. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T19:35:10Z] WARN kvcache: miss, fetching async
[2026-03-15T19:35:10Z] ERROR inference: request timeout after 10s
```
kevin (sre-oncall): OK, mitigation options: 1) scale canary down to 0 (full rollback) 2) enable circuit breaker to reject >5s requests 3) route canary traffic to fallback model variant. My preference: immediate rollback to v1.9.1 while we debug. What impact on SLAs?
maria (support): We have 3 open tickets from customers A/B showing timeouts and error spikes. They reported failures since ~19:30 UTC. They'll escalate if this persists.
anna (eng-release): Rolling back now -> `opsctl release rollback deploy-20260315-1932 --to deploy-20260314-2310`
opsbot: rollback initiated by anna (eng-release) at 2026-03-15T19:36:22Z. Traffic switching: canary -> 0, primary -> v1.9.1.
pagerbot: Update: 5xx rate dropping from 6.2% -> 1.1% (1m). p99 trending down to 0.9s.
kevin (sre-oncall): Good. I've also opened a temporary reject-rule at the gateway to return 429 for requests >8s to avoid queued long tails: `gatewayctl set-slo --max-latency 8s --policy reject`
dinesh (infra): Captured heap/kv metrics from canary machines, pushing to /tmp/canary-dump-1936.tar.gz for the infra team. I'll replay locally. Looks like quantized kernel path increases KV lookup jitter under certain sequence-length patterns.
anna (eng-release): Noting follow-up action: revert quantized kernel optimizations for v1.9.2, add regression test for long-tail sequences.
maria (support): Notifying affected customers and marking tickets as 'mitigated - rollback in progress'. I'll post a short status update to customers.
kevin (sre-oncall): Oncall handoff: I'll monitor for 30m then hand to next shift. Please create an incident report and attach the canary logs + rollback timeline. tagging ops for postmortem.
opsbot: Incident created: INC-20260315-42. Severity: Sev2. Owner: kevin (sre-oncall).
anna (eng-release): Thanks all. Postmortem owners: anna + dinesh + kevin. I'll follow up with a small canary experiment plan to test kernel toggles.
kevin (sre-oncall): Final check: current p99 0.85s, 5xx rate 0.9%. Closing active paging channel, leaving incident open for postmortem. :thumbsup:
maria (support): Will update customers with recovery note and ETA for root cause timeline.
kevin (sre-oncall): handing off monitoring to next oncall at 2026-03-15T20:06:20Z. If anything regresses re-page immediately.
pagerbot: Monitoring note: continuing 1m check, alert threshold lowered for 2h.
